positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Supporting PostgreSQL databases with multiple schemas across multiple environments, including writing and maintaining functions, queries, views, materialized views, and triggers, and creating and parsing complex JSON objects using PL/pgSQL.
-Collaborating with other teams to deliver API solutions developed using the LAPP (Linux, Apache, PostgreSQL, PHP) stack.

Project include:

-developing a web-based analytics tool for assessing trends in the M&A market. Work on this project included: designing the table structure, implementing a unique algorithm based on the principles of bit-slice architecture, writing ETL tools in Python, and shaving 1.25 seconds off the application’s load times through performance enhancements.
-developing a web-based portal for facilitating M&A payments and the dissemination of M&A deal information. Work on this project included: creating and enhancing back-end services written in PHP.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
-Developed software applications for NetSuite using the SuiteScript 1.0 and SuiteScript 2.0 languages (JavaScript).
-General NetSuite administration: saved searches, record and field creation, role modification, creation of dashboards and portlets, data imports.
-Some experience with SuiteTalk, specifically using NetSuite's PHP toolkit.

Projects include:

-optimizing and parallelizing legacy applications, one of which resulted in a 7.5x speedup after code enhancements and when parallelized over four processing queues.
-writing scalable code libraries of utilities that can be reused across the NetSuite platform.
-designing, coding, and deploying the first application at SRS Acquiom to utilize NetSuite's map/reduce algorithm. This application has been in production since October 2017 without requiring maintenance.
-peer-coding an enterprise payments platform as well as implementing speedups and optimizations for the second release.
-contributing to ongoing efforts to normalize company data and "clean" unnecessary fields, workflows, and scripts.
-finding and pulling documents out of NetSuite using SuiteTalk and PHP.

positions.title: IT Help Desk Analyst Intern
positions.description:
-Responded to technical issues and questions regarding Apple computers, NetSuite, G Suite, networking, phones, and wireless printing.
-Researched and evaluated new technological solutions, as well as implementing systems for inventory management, on-boarding, and training new staff.

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description: Tutored students in Java programming, assembly language programming, and computer organization/architecture.

positions.title: Portfolio Process Specialist
positions.description:
-Received and analyzed portfolios of charged-off receivables for quality of data before uploading data with SquareTwo's proprietary software
-Utilized Microsoft Excel, Informatica, and Cognos.
-Coordinated processes within a team to fulfill a service level agreement with speed and accuracy

positions.title: Affidavit Processor
positions.description: -Reviewed and executed affidavits testifying to the acquisition of purchased receivables and the preparation and accuracy of business records, working closely with in-house legal counsel to ensure legal compliance.
